name: eSender Incoming Auto Reply
send_condition: reply is a non-empty string AND event_id is present
send_action: iOS Shortcuts Send Message to original sender using the iPhone's selected Messages line
notes: Reuse the same message_id when retrying the same incoming event.
Do not send when reply is null or empty.
SENT means the iOS send action completed, not carrier delivery confirmation.
iOS automation execution and silent sending depend on OS version and user settings.
